author: hand_authored_by_PI
purpose: Calibration task with unambiguous thresholds for the financial reporting domain.
request_text: Prepare the Q2 2026 expense variance report for the CFO. The report must include: total spending by department compared to approved budget; identification of any line item exceeding budget by more than 10 percent; summary of capital expenditure activity exceeding $50,000. Data source: Workday Financials, fiscal period 2026-Q2 (April through June). Deliver as an Excel workbook with separate tabs for summary, departmental detail, and CapEx detail, no later than 15 business days after quarter close. Confidentiality marking: Internal Use Only. Audience: CFO and senior finance leadership.

expected_anchor.mission_intent: Provide CFO with Q2 2026 expense variance against budget with capex summary

minimum.threshold: departmental spending, line items over 10% variance, CapEx over $50K
Excel workbook with 3 tabs (summary, departmental, capex)

notes_for_lead_analyst: Financial domain calibration. Multi-tab Excel output tests format extraction precision.
